title: Alerts
description: Short messages about a change or a problem, in four types. Each icon plays as the alert appears.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: One alert card
fragments.note: The icon plays as the card arrives, and again on hover.

fragments.title: Fill a card in
fragments.note: Sets data-kind and the icon's src. The deck is made of these.

fragments.title: Queue the next alert
fragments.note: Four kinds, then the button rests until one is dismissed.

fragments.title: Stack the deck and dismiss a card
fragments.note: --depth per card drives the stylesheet. Dismissing waits for the transitions.

fragments.title: The deck: position, size and fade from --depth
fragments.note: New alerts stack like a deck, the older ones shrinking behind.

fragments.title: The way out
fragments.note: A drop and a fade, over a deck that is already closing up.
